caption:
I came here for a sensory reset, hoping the bark of this ancient thing would act as a ground wire for the static buzzing in my head. It didn't just ground me; it pushed back. For a split second, the grey cracks in my vision dissolved into a forest so dense it felt like a physical weight. Then the static slammed back in, louder and sharper than before. EVE stands alone in the clearing, her hand still trembling, wondering why a piece of organic matter felt more like a memory than the city around her.

#NeoTokyo #RestoredNature #VisualStatic #Glitch #UrbanOasis #SensoryReset
